verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents a Source Map Upload API that un-minifies JavaScript stack traces when source maps are provided (docs-16, docs-28). It can also fetch source maps from your servers (docs-25). So the core outcome is delivered, and CI could script the upload against the API. However, the evidenced CLI shows only a `deploy` command, and nothing shows a CLI source-map upload command or a bundler plugin (webpack/Vite/Rollup). Missing for 10: a documented CLI source-map upload command, a bundler plugin for CI uploads, and independent or hands-on corroboration of de-minified stack traces.
